enabled.description: Whether the Lomiri nextcloud carddav plugin profile is enabled.

hidden.description: Whether the profile is hidden from the user interface.

use_accounts.description: Whether to use existing system accounts for authentication.

schedule_enabled.description: Whether background syncing is enabled for the CardDAV profile.

schedule_interval.description: Interval for background sync (e.g., '15m', '1h'). Empty for default or disabled.

schedule_days.description: Comma-separated list of days for background sync (1=Mon, ..., 7=Sun).

schedule_time.description: Time of day to trigger background sync.
